description: This file is a shell script primarily for testing CRLF line ending conversions using git attributes and commands. It defines multiple functions to create test files with various line ending styles, check warnings, perform commits, and validate file states in a Git repository. The script includes extensive test cases covering different configurations of core.autocrlf, core.eol, and gitattributes, emphasizing handling of line endings, binary files, and attribute precedence.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after converting line endings to a canonical form and removes temporary files after comparison.

methods.name: compare_ws_file
methods.description: Compares two files with modifications to handle whitespace and line ending markers for testing.

methods.name: create_gitattributes
methods.description: Creates a .gitattributes file with specified attributes for testing line ending behaviors.

methods.name: create_NNO_MIX_files
methods.description: Creates and copies test files with different line endings and attributes for testing.

methods.name: check_warning
methods.description: Checks the warning messages generated during git operations based on line ending conversion warnings.

methods.name: commit_check_warn
methods.description: Performs commits with various attribute settings and verifies expected warnings.

methods.name: commit_MIX_chkwrn
methods.description: Sets up test files with mixed line endings and commits to validate warning behaviors.

methods.name: stats_ascii
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the style ('lf', 'crlf', 'mixed') based on input code.

methods.name: attr_ascii
methods.description: Converts attribute flags into human-readable string representations.

methods.name: check_files_in_repo
methods.description: Compares files in the repository against expected files for line ending correctness.

methods.name: check_in_repo_NNO
methods.description: Performs detailed checks on files in the NNO test set with specific attributes.

methods.name: checkout_files
methods.description: Simulates checkout operations with various configurations; verifies the resulting file line endings and attributes.
